FROM buildpack-deps:jammy
WORKDIR /testbed

# Configure apt reliability for eval image builds
RUN printf '%s\n' 'Acquire::Retries "5";' 'Acquire::http::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::https::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::http::Pipeline-Depth "0";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99jayint-retries

# Install git for cloning
RUN command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y git)

# Dependency-manager helpers inferred from verified setup
# No extra dependency bootstrap needed

# Clone repository and checkout base commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/Yelp/dumb-init /testbed
# No base commit provided; using repository default branch HEAD

# Agent's verified setup instructions
RUN make build
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip3 install -r requirements-dev.txt' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip3 install -e .' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN echo 'DUMB_INIT_BINARY = "/testbed/dumb-init"' >> tests/conftest.py

# Post-setup compatibility helpers inferred from verified setup
# No post-setup compatibility helpers needed
eval_script:
#!/bin/bash

cd /testbed


cd /testbed

set +e
(
DUMB_INIT_BINARY=/testbed/dumb-init pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings
)
TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
set -e

echo "echo OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$TEST_EXIT_CODE"
exit $TEST_EXIT_CODE

cat tests/cli_test.py (step 10, rejected because combined mutations)
grep -r "DUMB_INIT_BINARY" tests/ . 2>/dev/null || echo "..." (step 14, failed due to syntax error)

build_recipe.rationale: The Docker build recipe includes the persistent state-changing commands from the successful setup trajectory: system package installation, compilation of the dumb-init binary via make, installation of Python test dependencies from requirements-dev.txt, installation of the dumb-init package itself via pip install -e ., and the addition of the DUMB_INIT_BINARY constant to the conftest.py file which is required for test collection. All read-only inspections, failed attempts, and the final test command are excluded. The order follows the chronological sequence of successful actions.
